eps.ov: Hime's sister appears to teach the Ring Maidens how to use magic.
Satou and the Princesses enter the Elves' Great Library and learn more of the truth about the first Ring King.
Each Princess gets a few minutes alone in a bedroom with Satou to deepen their bonds.
Everyone has adapted too well to living in the Library, but when a monster attacks, Granart awakens her magic.
Hime strengthens the bonds between Ring Princesses allowing them to escape the Library and head to the Empire.
Hime learns to use light magic while Nefritis and Granart also train at the Spire. Satou tours the empire.
Satou breaks into the Mythic Armory, chats with the Emperor, and goes to pick up Hime from the Spire.
Satou enters the illusory world of Hime's tower to confront her fears and bring her back from the Abyss.
The group travels to the Great Mountain Wall and prepares to launch an attack against the Abyss King.
Satou's group steels their resolve and invades the Abyss King's castle to begin their final battle.
Satou and the princesses fight the Abyss King and the forces of the Abyss.
The final battle against the Abyss reaches its ultimate conclusion.
